reason: A DSH plugin that provides persistent project memory, precedent retrieval, and workflow guards for coding-agent sessions, with optional semantic search.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编码代理提供跨会话项目记忆、历史先例检索和工作流约束工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness coding agents with cross-session project memory, precedent retrieval, and workflow controls.

capabilities: Installs and configures a DSH agent preset
Adds agent-plane tools for project-memory retrieval and workflow control
Stores and retrieves learned project knowledge and session precedents
Applies scope, edit-intent, and version-guard checks to agent actions
Optionally runs a semantic-search helper that downloads and caches an embedding model
